# 5 bed semi-detached house for sale

> 5 bedroom 2 storey house on Main Street, Arva. Co Cavan. Accessibility to the rear of the home from Main Street ( as seen in pictures). Arva offers many amenities- churches, school, cafe, hotel, bus services and renowned lakes. Less than a 30 minute drive to Cavan and Longford. Unique town house offering large garden and outdoor space in the heart of this historic town.
